title: Evaluation of Dynamic Cointegration-Based Pairs Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Market
claim_summary: Scenario 1 ADF variant: OLS spread, Engle-Granger/ADF 1% selection, OU parameter estimation, and weekly trading after a three-month formation window on BitMEX futures/perpetuals.
entry_rule: Construct S=P1-beta*P2-alpha using OLS; retain Engle-Granger/ADF 1% pairs, estimate OU theta with lambda=theta_hat and N_SMA=2/lambda-1 for rolling mean/std; with Z, enter long when Z[t-2] < -2 and Z[t-1] > -2, or enter short when Z[t-2] > +2 and Z[t-1] < +2.
exit_rule: With the same rolling Z, exit long when Z[t-2] > -1 and Z[t-1] < -1, or exit short when Z[t-2] < +1 and Z[t-1] > +1.
sizing_rule: Use integerized pair coefficients and approximately 1 XBT capital per one-week trading period.
universe: BitMEX cryptocurrency futures and perpetual contracts
ambiguities: This is the paper's ADF variant only, not the other two scenarios.
Best bid/ask execution is recorded as a context-only assumption; exact fee and residual rounding conventions remain unspecified.
claimed_results: unverified: paper evaluates the Scenario 1 ADF variant
